correctness.rationale: Direct expansion of the two-site projectors and orthogonality of 0 and ±a modulation characters give an exact three-band Parseval identity and all singular values. Reciprocal symmetry and a signed derivative prove the unique balancing optimum. Divisor-order monotonicity proves the arithmetic support-step classification; the exceptional even-order equal-weight rank defect is included. The actual standalone matrix-SVD verification returned 200 matches in 50 tested geometries, with maximal spectral error 1.22e-14. Numerical checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The worst-case Hilbert–Schmidt reconstruction noise amplification of the maximal observable operator band is a natural design objective for sparse spectrogram sensing. The exact all-dimensions optimizer prevents a rank-defect at equal weights on even-order cycles and keeps condition number at most sqrt(5); the least odd prime divisor gives an exact arithmetic choice of optimal temporal lag. This is more than a numerical spectrum or a fixed-parameter re-expression: it is a complete constrained design theorem with unique optimizer classes. No claim of universal nonlinear phase-retrieval stability is made.
